subject: Champion handshake + schedule recon — initial discovery
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Gomez <lisa@stratagem.io>, Tom Brewer <t.brewer@stratagem.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0400
Subject: Champion handshake + schedule recon — initial discovery

Hi Lisa / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the call with us. Per our brief earlier, I'd like to get a short initial discovery on the calendar to: (1) introduce the Redwood team, (2) align on high-level success criteria, and (3) carve out a technical deep-dive for your engineering lead.

Proposed 45–60 min slots (ET):
- Tue Oct 5: 10:00–11:00
- Wed Oct 6: 14:00–15:00
- Thu Oct 7: 09:00–10:00

Ben (SE) and Dev (Infra) are cc'd — please let us know which slot works best and whether we should loop in procurement/security upfront (if so, please share the best contact).

Quick agenda we plan to cover:
- 10 min: intros + champion context (Lisa)
- 25–30 min: technical intake (Tom + SE)
- 10–15 min: next steps / procurement checklist

I've attached a short "security evidence ask" doc to make it easy to surface anything your team typically needs ahead of time. If any of these windows don't work, tell us alternatives and we'll pivot.

Thanks — looking forward to connecting.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai | M: +1 415-555-0182

Attachments: security-evidence-ask.pdf

From: Lisa Gomez <lisa@stratagem.io>

Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0400

Evelyn — thanks for the clear options.

We can definitely do Wed Oct 6 but 14:00 ET cuts into a prep meeting on our side — would you have any flexibility to move it up to 11:00–12:00 ET on the 6th? If not, we can keep 14:00 but wanted to check.

Please include procurement (procurement@stratagem.io) on the thread — they'll need the security checklist. Tom (engineering lead) will be on the call.

Cheers,
Lisa Gomez
Senior Product Manager, Stratagem Analytics

Also — a heads-up on the security items: the attached list from Evelyn is great; if you can surface network allowlist IPs and a contact for SOC2 evidence that would speed procurement.

Thanks for the quick replies — good call on 11:00 ET on Wed Oct 6. We'll tentatively hold Wed Oct 6, 11:00–12:00 ET.

I'll send a calendar invite in a moment with Google Meet and an agenda that splits the call into:
- 5 min: intros + objectives (Lisa)
- 25 min: technical intake & demo (Ben + Tom)
- 20 min: procurement/security Q&A (procurement team)

Two small logistics items:
- I'll include a DocuSign link for a lightweight NDA pre-signed by Redwood so procurement can skip steps if you prefer (link in invite).
- Please flag any required IP allowlist ranges ahead of time — Ben/Dev will use that to confirm the demo environment connectivity.

Attaching updated agenda (demo-agenda-v2.pdf). If procurement needs a separate pre-call, we can schedule a 15-min slot after this meeting.

Thanks — invite incoming.

Best,

Account Executive, Redwood Inference
